customer_email.description: Customer email address captured when the subscription was created.

currency.description: ISO currency code for recurring charges.

recurring_amount.description: Amount charged for each recurring billing cycle.

first_payment_amount.description: Initial customer-initiated payment amount, or null when not applicable.

start_date.description: Date from which billing can start.

end_date.description: Optional date after which AutoPay must stop billing.

cancel_at_period_end.description: Whether the subscription is scheduled to cancel at the current period end.

canceled_at.description: Timestamp when the subscription was canceled, or null if it is not canceled.

cancellation_initiator.description: Actor that initiated cancellation, such as merchant or customer.

agreement_id.description: Agreement identifier supplied during Checkout subscription creation.

next_billing_date.description: Next scheduled billing date, or null when no future charge is scheduled.

merchant_reference.description: Merchant reference attached to the subscription.

retry_window_days.description: Number of days AutoPay may keep retrying a failed billing cycle.

retry_count.description: Maximum retry attempts AutoPay may make for a failed billing cycle.

created_at.description: Timestamp when AutoPay created the subscription record.
